blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep neural networks deployed on smart glasses must adapt to changes in the distribution of incoming data while adhering to strict privacy and device constraints. We present No Frames, Just Frequencies, a bandwidth-efficient source-assisted adaptation framework that characterizes distribution shifts using compact frequency descriptors computed on-device. Rather than transmitting camera frames, the glasses compute and send frequency descriptors to a host device that contains a replica of the model. The host device maps the received frequency descriptor to a distribution shift operator that synthesizes out-of-distribution data and adapts a model replica using a pre-defined adaptation protocol. We evaluate the framework on mixtures of ImageNet-C corruptions using convolution-based (ConvNeXtV2-Femto), self-attention-based (DeiT-Tiny), and hybrid (TinyViT-5M) vision models, on person classification (Visual Wake Words), and on object detection (MS-COCO). Our results reveal that adaptation driven solely by the transmitted descriptors recovers $93-95\%$ of the supervised oracle adaptation gain on all three architectures, $82\%$ on Visual Wake Words and $94$--$98\%$ on MS-COCO. Notably, adaptation quality degrades gracefully as the descriptor resolution decreases from $224 $ to $28$ pixels, consistently across architectures, enabling bandwidth reductions from $213\times$ to $784\times$ across the frequency descriptors.
blocks.zh: 部署在智能眼镜上的深神经网络必须适应来信数据分布的变化,同时遵守严格的隐私和装置限制. 我们提出 " 无框架 " , " Just Frequenies " ,这是一个带宽效率高的源辅助适应框架,其特征是使用紧凑的频率描述符在设备上计算,进行分配。 眼镜与其传输相机相框,不如计算并发送频率描述符给包含模型复制品的宿主设备. 主机设备将接收到的频率描述符映射到一个分布式移位操作员,该移位操作员会利用预先定义的适应协议来合成出放数据并调整出一个模型复制. 我们评价关于ImageNet-C腐败的混合物的框架,使用以革命为基础的(ConvNetV2-Femto)、以自觉为基础的(DeiT-Tiny)和混合的(TinyViT-5M)视觉模型,以及人分类(Visual Wake Words)和物体检测(MS-CO)。 我们的结果表明,完全由传送的描述器驱动的适应措施,从所有三种建筑的受监督的甲骨文适应收益中回收了93-95美元,从视觉醒目词条中回收了82美元,从MS-CO中回收了94美元-98美元。 值得注意的是,适应质量被轻而易举地降低,因为描述器分辨率从224美元降至28美元等效物,整个结构一致,使得频率描述器的带宽从213美元降至784美元。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Deep neural network (DNN) models deployed at the edge often lack robustness when the input data ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) drift from the training data, degrading the model’s prediction quality ( Saukh et al., 2023 ) . Practical deployments must additionally cope with dynamic resource constraints ( e.g. , fluctuating energy budgets and latency requirements), which may require rapid, runtime reconfiguration of the deployed model ( Corti et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 当输入数据(Hendrycks and Dietrich, 2019)从训练数据漂移时, 部署在边缘的深神经网络(DNN)模型往往缺乏坚固性, 实际部署必须进一步应对动态资源限制(例如,变化不定的能源预算和暂时性要求),这可能需要迅速对部署的模型进行周期性重组(Corti等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Smart glasses represent an especially demanding edge setting: they must continuously process video streams within tight latency and power-efficiency budgets while operating in close physical proximity to the user ( Karakostas and others, 2024 ) . The motivation for on-device intelligence is therefore dual: local inference minimizes dependence on network connectivity ( Zhou et al., 2019 ) , and processing video data on-device reduces the exposure of raw visual content, which on smart glasses may contain sensitive information ( e.g. , faces, screens, locations) that should not leave the device.
blocks.zh: 智能眼镜代表着一个要求特别高的边缘环境:他们必须在紧凑的休闲和电力效率预算范围内不断处理视频流,同时在接近用户的实际操作(Karakostas等人,2024年). 因此,在线智能的动机是双重的:局部推论尽量减少了对网络连通性的依赖(周等人,2019年),处理视频数据在设备上减少原始视觉内容的曝光,在智能眼镜上,原始视觉内容可能包含不应离开设备的敏感信息(如面部,屏幕,位置).

blocks.en: Privacy is not the only constraint: smart glasses also operate under severe hardware resource limitations. While edge-designed convolutional architectures such as MobileNets ( Howard et al., 2017 ) and EfficientNet ( Tan and Le, 2019 ) have made inference practical on edge devices, adaptation remains the bottleneck for both convolution- and attention-based models ( Lin et al., 2023b ) , since gradient-based methods must store intermediate activations and optimizer states, substantially increasing the memory footprint beyond inference alone ( Slamanig et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2022 ) . As a wearable camera moves through heterogeneous environments, the visual stream experiences rapid changes in illumination and motion blur, producing non-stationary shifts over time ( Quiñonero-Candela et al., 2008 ; Yao et al., 2022 ) that degrade the predictive quality of the deployed model, thus adaptation must operate continuously during deployment.
blocks.zh: 隐私并不是唯一的制约因素:智能眼镜也在硬件资源严重限制下运行. 虽然边缘设计的演化架构,如MobileNets(Howard等人,2017年)和高效网(Tan and Le,2019年)使得边缘设备的推论具有实用性,但适应仍然是基于演化和关注的模型(Lin等人,2023年b)的瓶颈,因为基于梯度的方法必须存储中间激活和优化状态,极大地提升了记忆足迹,超越了仅推论(Slamanig等人,2025年;Xu等人,2022年). 由于可穿戴的相机通过不同的环境移动,视觉流会经历照明和运动模糊的快速变化,随时间推移产生非固定的转变(Quiñonero-Candela等人,2008年;姚等人,2022年),从而降低部署模型的预测质量,因此适应必须在部署期间持续进行.

blocks.en: Test-Time Adaptation ( TTA ) adapts pre-trained models to changes in data distribution at test time by using each data point once for post-inference adaptation ( Sun et al., 2020 ) . Existing TTA methods expose two methodological gaps for resource-constrained edge devices, such as smart glasses. First, popular approaches such as entropy minimization ( Wang et al., 2021a ) may fail under certain shifts and amplify the model’s prediction errors without safeguards ( Press et al., 2024 ) . Second, they assume mini-batches large enough (or an auxiliary cache) to estimate accurate target statistics. Under realistic on-device constraints, where only a few samples may be available, the model’s performance can degrade sharply and may even collapse for online adaptation batches due to unreliable statistics estimation or noisy gradient adaptation ( Su et al., 2024 ; Niu et al., 2023 ) . Prior work mitigates these methodological gaps by emulating larger effective batches with gradient accumulation ( Lin et al., 2023a ) or by constructing a virtual batch via test-time augmentations ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) , which conflicts with strict memory and privacy restrictions when storing or replaying visual samples on smart glasses.
blocks.zh: 试验-时间适应(TTA )通过一次使用每个数据点进行推导后适应,对试验时的数据分布变化进行预先训练的模型进行调整(Sun等人,2020年). 现有的TTA方法暴露了资源约束边缘设备的两个方法漏洞,如智能眼镜. 首先,像Entropy最小化(Wang等人,2021年a)这样的流行方法可能会在某些转变下失败,并在没有保障措施的情况下扩大模型的预测错误(Press等人,2024年). 其次,它们假定微型枪管足够大(或辅助缓存),可以估计准确的目标统计数据. 在现实条件下,即可能只有少数样本可用的情况下,模型的性能会急剧下降,甚至可能因统计数据估计不可靠或梯度适应噪音而崩溃(Su等人,2024年;Niu等人,2023年)。 先前的工作通过仿照较大的有效批次的梯度积累(Lin等人,2023a)或通过测试时间增强(Zhang等人,2022年)构建虚拟批次,缓解了这些方法上的漏洞,在智能眼镜上存储或重放视觉样本时与严格的内存和隐私限制相冲突.

blocks.en: Our approach to bandwidth-efficient deployment-time adaptation satisfies three requirements: ( i ) it avoids streaming camera frames over the bandwidth-limited uplink by relying on compact, privacy-enhancing distribution-shift frequency descriptors computed on-device; ( ii ) it offloads the gradient adaptation step to a nearby host device to respect the glasses’ tight compute and memory budgets, restricting the adaptation to a small parameter subset; ( iii ) it couples adaptation with an explicit characterization of the distribution shift affecting the model’s predictions under non-stationary streams. Concretely, the edge device computes a compact frequency descriptor for each frame and transmits it to a host device (Fig. 1 ). These descriptors capture only the spectral magnitude, discarding the phase information and aggregating the spectrum into as few as 14 floating-point values, so that the per-frame uplink fits within a low-bandwidth wireless link budget. The host device maps the received descriptor to a four-stage causal corruption directed acyclic graph (DAG), synthesizes adaptation batches from pre-stored in-distribution data, adapts a model replica on a compact subspace via supervised cross-entropy, and transmits the adapted parameters back to the smart glasses, thereby closing the adaptation loop without transmitting camera frames; we term this setting source-assisted adaptation . Our contributions are: • We propose No Frames, Just Frequencies (NFJF), a bandwidth-efficient source-assisted adaptation framework for smart glasses that characterizes distribution shifts using compact on-device frequency descriptors and offloads adaptation to a paired host. • We design a multi-stage corruption classifier that maps a frequency descriptor to a four-stage causal corruption directed acyclic graph (Weather → \rightarrow Blur → \rightarrow Noise → \rightarrow Digital), paired with a synthetic data-generation pipeline that reconstructs the detected distribution shift from labeled in-distribution data samples. • We conduct a systematic evaluation across three architecture families (convolution, self-attention, and hybrid), three frequency descriptors (RAPSD, DCT, DWT), and four input resolutions, against 63 63 mixtures of corruptions. • We extend the framework to person classification and object detection, analyze the adaptation accuracy of the frequency descriptor against model-based distribution shift descriptors, and measure the end-to-end latency of the adaptation loop on smart-glasses class hardware.
blocks.zh: 我们的带宽高效部署时间适应办法满足了三项要求:(一) 它依靠紧凑的、增强隐私的分配转换频率描述符,避免在带宽有限的上行线上流相机框;(二) 它向附近的主机设备卸下梯度调整步骤,以尊重眼镜的严格计算和内存预算,限制调整到一个小参数子集;(三) 它与分配变化的明确特征相配,影响模型在非固定流下的预测。 具体来说,边缘设备为每个帧计算一个紧凑的频率描述符,并将其传送到主机设备(图1). 这些描述符只捕捉光谱量,丢弃相位信息,将光谱汇总为多达14个浮点值,使每帧上行链路适合低频段无线链路预算. 主机设备将接收到的描述符映射到一个四级因果腐败方向的循环图(DAG),从预先存储的分散数据中合成适应批次,通过有监督的交叉交替调整一个紧凑的子空间上的模型复制件,并将经过调整的参数传送回智能眼镜,从而在不传送相机帧的情况下关闭适应循环;我们称这个设定源辅助适应. 我们的贡献是: • 我们提议不设帧,Just Frequenies(NFJF),这是智能眼镜带宽效率高的源辅助适应框架,其特征是使用紧凑的机载频率描述器和卸载量适应成对主机的分布变化。 我们设计了一个多阶段的腐败分类器,将频率描述符映射到一个四阶段的因果腐败指示环形图(Weather →\Rightarrow Bluer →\Rightar Noise →\Rightarrow Digital),与合成数据生成管道配对,该管道从标注的分布数据样本中重建检测到的分布转移. 我们针对63种腐败的混合物,对三个建筑家族(革命、自觉和混合)、三个频率描述符(RAPSD、DCT、DWT)和四个投入解决方案进行系统评估。 我们把框架扩展为人分类和对象检测,对照基于模型的分布移描述符分析频率描述符的适应精度,并测量智能眼镜类硬件上适应圈的端到端间隔.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 1 . System overview of the proposed bandwidth-efficient TTA framework. An edge device ( i.e. , Smart Glasses) computes compact frequency descriptors (RAPSD, DCT, or DWT statistics) from incoming camera frames on-device. Only these descriptors are transmitted to the host device, keeping the per-frame uplink within a low-bandwidth budget instead of streaming raw frames. The host device maps the received descriptor to a synthetic corruption distribution through a sequential pipeline of training corruptions. The host device generates synthetic corrupted data batches from locally stored in-distribution images, and adapts a model replica using a pre-defined adaptation protocol ( Lee et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2021a ) . Finally, the updated parameter subset is transmitted back to the edge device.
blocks.zh: 图1 拟议的带宽效率 TTA框架的系统概览. 一个边缘设备(即Smart Glasses)从接收到的相机帧上计算出紧凑的频率描述符(RAPSD,DCT,或DWT统计). 只有这些描述符被传送到主机设备,使每帧上行链路保持在低带宽预算范围内,而不是流化的原始帧. 东道主装置通过一系列培训腐败,将接收到的描述符映射为合成腐败的分布。 主机设备从本地存储的分散图像中生成合成腐烂的数据批次,并使用预定义的适应协议(Lee等人,2023年;Wang等人,2021a年)进行模型复制. 最后,更新的参数子集被传送回边缘设备.

blocks.en: Test-Time Adaptation ( TTA ) methods adapt pre-trained models to distribution shifts at deployment without access to the source training data or target labels ( Sun et al., 2020 ) . Test-time Adaptation by Entropy Minimization (TENT) ( Wang et al., 2021a ) minimizes the entropy of model predictions by re-estimating normalization statistics from the test batch and updating the affine parameters of normalization layers. SAR ( Niu et al., 2023 ) mitigates small-batch instability through sharpness-aware minimization and reliable sample filtering, and SPA ( Niu et al., 2025 ) enforces a consistency objective between clean and augmented inputs of Vision Transformers. Unlike these methods, which adapt on the unlabeled test stream itself, our framework keeps the test frames on the glasses and offloads gradient computation to a host that adapts on labeled, in-distribution images; it operates in a source-assisted regime rather than under the source-free, label-free assumption of TTA , in exchange for a bandwidth-efficient wireless transmission.
blocks.zh: 试验-时间适应(TTA)方法在部署时将预先训练的模型调整为分配变化,而无法获得源培训数据或目标标签(Sun等人,2020年)。 通过Entropy最小化(TENT)(Wang等人,2021a)的试验时间适应,通过从试验批量中重新评估正常化统计,更新正常化层的亲和参数,将模型预测的entropy最小化. SAR(Niu等人,2023年)通过敏锐感知最小化和可靠的样本过滤来减轻小批量的不稳定性,SPA(Niu等人,2025年)在Vision Transformers的清洁输入和增加输入之间执行一个一致性目标。 与这些在无标签测试流本身上适应的方法不同,我们的框架将测试帧保留在眼镜上,并卸载梯度计算到一个在有标签的,分散的图像上适应的主机上;它运行在源辅助制度下,而不是在TTA的无源,无标签假设下,以换取带宽高效的无线传输.

blocks.en: Adaptation Beyond TTA . Unsupervised domain adaptation assumes joint access to labeled source and unlabeled target images ( Ganin and Lempitsky, 2015 ) , whereas source-free domain adaptation discards the source data and adapts on unlabeled target samples alone ( Liang et al., 2020 ) ; continual TTA extends this setting to non-stationary target streams ( Liang et al., 2025 ) . Predictive domain adaptation infers the parameters of the target model from domain metadata, without any target data ( Mancini et al., 2019 ) and zero-shot domain adaptation generates a model for an unseen domain from a semantic domain descriptor ( Yang and Hospedales, 2014 ) . These approaches either observe target samples or specify the expected target conditions prior to deployment; NFJF instead estimates the shift online from the transmitted frequency descriptors and synthesizes the corresponding labeled adaptation data on the host.
blocks.zh: 适应超越TTA. 无监督域适应假设联合访问标签源和无标签目标图像(Ganin和Lempitsky,2015年),而无源域适应则丢弃来源数据,仅在无标签目标样本上进行适应(Liang等人,2020年);持续TTA将这一设置扩展到非固定目标流(Liang等人,2025年). 预测域适应从域元数据推断出目标模型的参数,没有任何目标数据(Mancini等人,2019年),零镜头域适应从语义域描述符(Yang and Hospedales,2014年)生成一个未见域模型. 这些方法要么观察目标样本,要么在部署前具体说明预期目标条件;NFJF则在网上估计从传输频率描述符的转变,并在主机上合成相应的标注适应数据.

blocks.en: Domain Adaptation via Frequency Manipulation. Prior work ( Yang and Soatto, 2020 ) shows that swapping the low-frequency amplitude components between source and target images supports semantic segmentation domain adaptation: the low-frequency amplitude tends to capture the style and domain-specific characteristics, while the phase encodes semantic content ( Xu et al., 2021 ) . Subsequent work on the frequency bias of deep neural networks ( Yin et al., 2019 ) shows that different corruption families concentrate their perturbation energy in distinct bands of the spatial-frequency spectrum, a property we exploit to classify corruptions from descriptors. In contrast to prior work, which manipulates frequencies for offline adaptation, we use frequency descriptors as a bandwidth-efficient communication primitive between an edge device and a host, and as the input to the corruption classifier that drives the synthesis of the labeled adaptation data.
blocks.zh: 通过频率操纵进行域适应. 先前的工作(Yang and Soatto,2020年)显示,将低频振幅组件在源图像和目标图像之间互换支持语义分割域适应:低频振幅倾向于捕捉样式和域特异性,而相位编码语义内容(Xu等人,2021年). 随后关于深神经网络频度偏差的研究表明(Yin等人,2019年),不同的腐败家庭将其扰动能量集中在空间频谱的不同波段,这是我们利用的财产,将来自描述器的腐败分类. 与之前操纵频率进行离线适应的工作相对,我们使用频率描述符作为边缘设备与主机之间的带宽效率通信原始,并作为驱动标签适应数据合成的腐败分类器的输入.

blocks.en: Privacy-Enhancing Edge Intelligence. Edge computing minimizes data transmission to reduce latency and preserve privacy ( Shi et al., 2016 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) ; federated learning ( McMahan et al., 2017 ) exchanges gradients rather than data, which requires on-device gradient computation, often not available on constrained edge devices such as smart glasses. Our framework transmits only frequency descriptors, whose phase is discarded, providing bandwidth savings over camera frame streaming and a privacy-enhancing alternative to gradient-sharing methods.
blocks.zh: 隐私 - 增强边缘情报。 边际计算将数据传输最小化,以减少耐久性并保持隐私(Shi等人,2016年;Zhou等人,2019年);联邦学习(McMahan等人,2017年)交换梯度而不是数据,这需要在线梯度计算,通常无法在智能眼镜等受限制的边缘设备上获得. 我们的框架只传输频率描述符,其相位被丢弃,通过相机帧流提供带宽节省,以及一种取代梯度共享方法的增强隐私的替代方法.

blocks.en: The Radially Averaged Power Spectral Density ( Van der Schaaf and van Hateren, 1996 ) characterizes the global distribution of signal energy across spatial frequencies. We compute RAPSD by applying a two-dimensional Fast Fourier Transform to the input image and averaging the power spectral density within concentric rings of increasing radius from the zero-frequency (DC) component, normalized by the number of pixels. This maps the two-dimensional spectrum to a compact one-dimensional vector of length N / 2 N/2 (for an N × N N\times N input), where each index corresponds to a spatial frequency band. By explicitly discarding phase and directional magnitude information, this representation becomes rotation-invariant.
blocks.zh: Radially平均功率光谱密度(Van der Schaaf和van Hateren,1996年)是信号能量在全球空间频率分布的特点。 我们计算RAPSD的方法是,在输入图像中应用二维Fast Fourier Transform,并平均从零频率(DC)组件中增加半径的同心环内的电源光谱密度,由像素数实现常态化. 这个图将二维频谱映射为长度为N / 2 N/2的紧凑的一维矢量(用于一个N × N N\ties N输入),其中每个索引对应一个空间频段. 通过明确丢弃相位和方向尺寸信息,这种表示会变得不易旋转。

blocks.en: The Discrete Cosine Transform ( Ahmed et al., 1974 ) descriptor relies on the block-based frequency decomposition found in standard image compression pipelines ( i.e. , JPEG, MPEG) ( Wallace, 1992 ) . We partition the input image into non-overlapping 8 × 8 8\times 8 blocks and apply the two-dimensional DCT-II to each block via separable matrix multiplication using an orthonormal basis, and aggregate the coefficients across all blocks into the mean absolute value and standard deviation for each frequency index. This descriptor can be computed from the codec’s pipeline. In contrast to RAPSD, this block-wise approach captures direction-specific texture signatures.
blocks.zh: Discrete Cosine Transform (Ahmed et al., 1974) 描述器依赖于标准图像压缩管道(即JPEG,MPEG)中发现的以块为基础的频率分解(Wallace, 1992). 我们将输入图像分割为8×8 8\时的8个区块,并通过可分离的矩阵乘法将二维的DCT-II应用到每个区块上,并用正向基数将所有区块的系数汇总到每个频率指数的平均绝对值和标准偏差中. 这种描述符可以从编码器的管道中计算出来。 与RAPSD形成对比的是,这种块形方法捕捉到方向特定纹理签名.

blocks.en: The Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) captures frequency characteristics across multiple spatial scales ( Mallat, 1989 ) . We use the Haar wavelet for its computational efficiency on edge hardware ( Konecny et al., 2024 ) , with three-level recursive decomposition ( L = 3 L=3 ); at each level, the image is decomposed into the approximation (LL), horizontal (LH), vertical (HL), and diagonal (HH) detail sub-bands. We retain the three detail sub-bands (LH, HL, HH) as well as the approximation sub-band (LL), at each level. For each sub-band, we compute four statistics (mean square energy, standard deviation, mean magnitude and peak value), yielding a fixed-size descriptor of 48 48 dimensions ( 3 3 levels × \times 4 4 sub-bands × \times 4 4 stats), regardless of the input resolution. DWT is part of the JPEG2000 standard ( Skodras et al., 2001 ) , thus these features could be extracted from existing encoder pipelines.
blocks.zh: Discrete Wavelet Transform(DWT)捕捉跨多个空间尺度的频率特征(Mallat,1989年) . 我们在边缘硬件(Konecny et al., 2024)上使用Haar波来进行计算效率,有三级递归分解(L=3 L=3);在每个级别上,图像分解为近似(LL),水平(LH),垂直(HL),二对角(HH)细小子波段. 我们保留三个细小的子带(LH,HL,HH)以及近似子带(LL),在每个级别上. 对于每个子波段,我们计算出四个统计(平均方能,标准偏差,平均规模和峰值),产生48维的固定尺寸描述符(3 3级×\times 4 4 个子波段×\times 4 4 个stats),无论输入分辨率如何. DWT是JPEG2000标准的一部分(Skodras等人,2001年),因此这些特性可以从现有的编码器管道中提取。

blocks.en: The classifier g ϕ g_{\phi} is a multi-head MLP: a shared feature extractor of three fully connected layers followed by one linear head per stage. blocks.en: Ultimately, G t ​ e ​ s ​ t G_{test} evaluates both the corruption classifier and the end-to-end adaptation pipeline performance. blocks.en: Oracle - E (Entropy Minimization). Following Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2021a ) , we minimize the entropy of the model’s softmax predictions on D s ​ y ​ n ​ t ​ h t ​ r ​ u ​ e D_{synth}^{true} , matching the adaptation budget of Oracle - CE . In line with the adaptation used in our method, the affine parameters of the normalization layers ( γ \gamma and β \beta ), as well as the first block ( Lee et al., 2023 ) , are adapted, while all other parameters remain frozen. This baseline serves as the reference for on-device unsupervised adaptation and requires access to all the corrupted data, unrealistic for edge deep learning inference frameworks, which lack gradient computation ( Lin et al., 2023b ) .
blocks.zh: Oracle - E(最小化输入). 追随王等. (Wang et al., 2021a),我们尽可能减少模型软马克斯预测在Ds y n h t r u D_{synth }^{ true},匹配甲骨文的适应预算-CE. 根据我们方法采用的适应方法,正常化层的近缘参数(γ\gamma和β\beta)以及第一个区块(Lee等人,2023年)进行了调整,而所有其他参数仍然冻结。 这一基线是未受监督的在线调整的参考,要求查阅所有被腐蚀的数据,对于边缘深层学习推论框架来说是不切实际的,这些框架缺乏梯度计算(Lin等人,2023年b).

blocks.en:
Oracle - CE (Supervised Cross Entropy). The Oracle adapts the model on D s ​ y ​ n ​ t ​ h t ​ r ​ u ​ e D_{synth}^{true} using ground-truth labels via cross-entropy loss (Eq. 3 ), updating affine parameters of the normalization layers, as well as the model’s first block ( Lee et al., 2023 ) .
Since it has access to both the ground-truth DAG and the corresponding labels, Oracle - CE serves as the empirical upper bound on the adaptation gain within our adaptation framework, and its gap to NFJF isolates the impact of predicting the corruption graph at test time. For the object detection task, the supervised oracle’s adaptation loss ( Oracle - CE + Reg. ) contains, in addition to the cross-entropy term, the bounding-box regression term, which penalizes the localization error between the predicted and the ground-truth bounding boxes.
blocks.zh:
Oracle - CE(超级十字环形山). Oracle在Ds y n t h t r u e D_{synth }^{ true 上对模型进行了调整,使用地面真实的标签通过交叉内损(Eq. 3),更新了正常化层的亲和参数,以及模型的第一个块(Lee等人,2023年).
由于Oracle-CE既可以获取地面真实的DAG,也可以获得相应的标签,因此它成为了我们适应框架内适应收益的经验性上限,它与NFJF的差距隔离了测试时预测腐败图的影响. 对于对象检测任务,被监督的甲骨文的适应性损失(Oracle - CE + Reg.)除了横切词外,还包含边框回归词,它惩罚了预测框和地面-真实边框之间的本地化错误.

blocks.en: 5.4. Experiments

Architectures. To assess the scalability of the framework across different classification models, we evaluate three architectures that span convolution, self-attention and hybrid designs: (i) ConvNeXtV2-Femto ( Woo et al., 2023 ) , a fully convolutional backbone with Layer Normalization; (ii) DeiT-Tiny ( Touvron et al., 2021 ) , a Vision Transformer backbone; (iii) TinyViT-5M ( Wu et al., 2022 ) , a hybrid convolution-transformer backbone using Batch Normalization in its convolution layers and Layer Normalization in its self-attention layers. All models contain approximately five million parameters, so that accuracy differences across the three paradigms reflect architectural design rather than scale. Following Lee et al. ( Lee et al., 2023 ) , we use Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) , learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} and batch size 64.

blocks.en: Resolution Scaling. Since the cost of computing the descriptors depends on the input resolution, we evaluate for each test graph the impact of different input resolutions on the adaptation accuracy gain. Each corrupted frame is re-encoded in memory as a JPEG at the maximum quality factor ( Q = 100 Q{=}100 ) and decoded directly at 1 / 8 1/8 , 1 / 4 1/4 , or 1 / 2 1/2 in the DCT domain with the TJpgDec library ( Krumpl et al., 2026 ) , mirroring the reduced-scale decode of embedded JPEG decoders; the maximum-quality setting minimizes compression artifacts. This spatial reduction acts as a low-pass filter (Fig. 3 ): the shot noise signature progressively diminishes as the resolution decreases, whereas contrast and brightness, which perturb the mid-to-low bands and the zero-frequency (DC) component, remain visible at every resolution scale.
blocks.zh: 决议缩放。 由于计算描述符的成本取决于输入分辨率,因此我们对每个测试图评价不同输入分辨率对适应精度增益的影响. 每个损坏的框架在内存中以JPEG最高质量因子(Q = 100 Q{=}100)重新编码,并直接以1/8 1/8,1 / 4 1/4,或1 / 2 1/2在DCT域与TJpgDec库(Krumpl等人,2026年)进行解码,镜像嵌入式JPEG解码器的缩小尺度解码;最高质量设置将压缩文物最小化. 这种空间缩小作用为低通滤波器(图3):随着分辨率的降低,镜头的噪声信号逐渐减弱,而反照率和亮度则在每一个分辨率尺度上都保持可见,它们扰动中低波段和零频(DC)部分.

blocks.en: 6.1. Adaptation Across Architectures and Resolutions
blocks.zh: 6.1. 跨越结构和决议的适应

blocks.en: On ImageNet-C (Fig. 2 , Fig. 4 ), we observe that NFJF recovers most of the supervised oracle adaptation gain. At the native 224 descriptor resolution, the strongest descriptor (DCT) recovers 93.1 % 93.1\% of the gain on ConvNeXtV2-Femto ( 59.34 % 59.34\% versus Oracle - CE 60.91 % 60.91\% , from a No Adapt accuracy of 37.99 % 37.99\% ), 93.3 % 93.3\% on DeiT-Tiny, and 94.7 % 94.7\% on TinyViT-5M. In contrast, Oracle - E , despite consuming the full corrupted stream ( D s ​ y ​ n ​ t ​ h t ​ r ​ u ​ e D_{synth}^{true} ), reports a notable adaptation gain only on the convolution architecture and shows adaptation collapse in the self-attention and hybrid architectures, the known degeneracy of the entropy objective into a trivial constant-prediction solution ( Press et al., 2024 ; Niu et al., 2023 ) . For every architecture the adaptation gains grow monotonically with the descriptor resolution (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 在ImageNet-C(图2,图4)上,我们看到NFJF回收了大部分受监督的甲骨文适应收益. 在原著224的描述解析中,最强的描述解析器(DCT)从ConvNEXtV2-Femto(59.34%59.34\%对甲骨文-CE 60.91%60.91%60.91%),DeiT-Tiny(93.3%)和TinyViT-5M(94.7%94.7%)获得收益。 与此相反,甲骨文-E尽管消耗了整个腐烂的溪流(Ds y n h t r u D_{synth }^{ true),但仅报告在演化结构上有显著的适应增益,并显示自觉和混合结构中的适应崩溃,已知的py目标退化成一个微不足道的恒定性解决方案(Press等人,2024年;Niu等人,2023年)。 每种建筑的适应收益都以描述性分辨率单调增长(图2)。

blocks.en: 6.2. Classifier Seed Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 6.2. 分类种子敏感性

blocks.en: We train two additional corruption classifiers per descriptor and input resolution with different random seeds and repeat the ImageNet-C adaptation loop with each classifier on one transmitted descriptor per test DAG. We observe that the three classifiers predict the same DAG in 4% of the test cases at resolution 28 and in 59% at 224, whereas the standard deviation of the post-adaptation accuracy across the three classifiers ( 4.4 4.4 , 3.4 3.4 , 1.6 1.6 and 0.7 0.7 pp at 28 28 , 56 56 , 112 112 and 224 224 ) falls below the standard deviation across the three transmitted descriptors of the same DAG ( 7.3 7.3 , 5.2 5.2 , 3.8 3.8 and 2.5 2.5 pp; Sec. 4.1 ). The adaptation gain increases monotonically with the resolution for every classifier; thus the trends observed in Fig. 2 do not depend on the classifier seed, and the transmitted frame, rather than the classifier, is the major source of adaptation variability.

blocks.en: 6.3. Task Generality
blocks.zh: 6.3. 任务概况

blocks.en: Person Classification. On VWW (Table 2 ), we observe that NFJF improves the corrupted data accuracy from 65.3 % 65.3\% to 72.80 % 72.80\% (DWT at 96 96 resolution), closing 82 % 82\% of the 9.1 % 9.1\% adaptation gain of Oracle - CE , whereas Oracle - E falls below No Adapt . We note that the binary task compresses the adaptation gap range: the accuracy under shift is bounded by No Adapt at 65.3 65.3 % on average, thus the margin recoverable through adaptation is correspondingly small. We believe the fraction of the NFJF versus oracle adaptation gap is therefore a more informative statistic than the adaptation gain.
blocks.zh: 人物分类. 关于VWW(表2),我们注意到NFJF改进了腐烂的数据精度,从65.3%的65.3\%提高到72.80%的72.80\%(DWT,96 96分辨率),在甲骨文-CE-9.1%的适应收益中,82%的82\%关闭,而甲骨文-E低于无适应。 我们注意到,二进制任务压缩了适应差距范围:转动中的精度以无适应能力为界,平均为65.3 65.3%,因此通过适应可回收的比值相应小。 因此,我们认为NFJF与甲骨文适应差距的一小部分是比适应收益更翔实的统计数据。

blocks.en: Object Detection. On MS-COCO (Table 2 ), we observe that NFJF improves box mAP from 7.4 7.4 to 11.8 11.8 on SSDLite320 (DWT at 320 input resolution), against an oracle adaptation accuracy of 12.1 12.1 ( 93.6 93.6 % of the achievable gain), and from 8.8 8.8 to 16.9 16.9 on YOLOX-Tiny against 17.1 17.1 ( 97 97 %). The adaptation gap closure is highest on detection compared to classification, consistent with the denser per-image supervision detection objective ( i.e. , per-anchor classification and regression ground-truth boxes).

blocks.en: 6.4. Descriptor Ablation

To isolate the contribution of the frequency descriptor, we re-run the adaptation loop at the native 224 224 resolution with the descriptor replaced by model-based alternatives (Fig. 5 ): ActStats , the first layer and block activation statistics, and FeatFinal , the pre-logits embedding. We observe that ActStats attains the highest adaptation accuracy on every architecture, improving on DCT by 0.67 0.67 pp on average and approaching Oracle - CE to within 0.63 0.63 pp on average, whereas FeatFinal falls below DCT and DWT on every architecture, 5.1 5.1 pp below ActStats on average: the corruption DAG is better identified from the low-level spectral content preserved by the first layers rather than from the pre-logits embedding. We believe the frequency descriptors remain the better choice under deployment constraints, since the 0.67 0.67 pp adaptation increase of ActStats costs on average 2.3 × 2.3\times the DCT payload and ≈ 100 × \approx 100\times its FLOPs.

blocks.en: 6.5. Privacy Leakage Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.5 隐私泄漏分析

blocks.en: We consider an eavesdropper on the wireless uplink that observes only the transmitted frequency descriptors. We measure the leakage with a classifier that predicts a sensitive attribute, the person-presence label of VWW, from the single descriptor ( Malekzadeh et al., 2019 ) . We split the descriptor-classifier test images into training and test (80:20), apply the 63 63 test DAGs, train a logistic regression, a gradient-boosted tree and an MLP classifier. We repeat the split five times and report the mean ( ± σ \pm\sigma ) of the most accurate of the three classifiers. We use the balanced accuracy, i.e. , the mean of the person and no-person accuracies, since VWW is not a balanced dataset. We observe that the most accurate eavesdropper obtains 58.5 ± 2.4 % 58.5{\pm}2.4\% (DCT at resolution 48 48 ), thus the descriptors carry a weak person-presence signal rather than disclosing the attribute. We note that the leakage is lowest at the lowest descriptor resolution for every descriptor and that it saturates as the resolution grows: averaged over the three descriptors, raising the resolution from 24 24 to 48 48 increases the adaptation gain by 1.0 1.0 pp and the leakage by 1.3 1.3 pp, whereas raising it from 48 48 to 96 96 increases the gain by 0.4 0.4 pp and the leakage by only 0.3 0.3 pp. We believe the descriptor resolution therefore trades adaptation gain for leakage mainly at the lowest resolutions range.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑在无线上行线上装一个窃听器 只观察传输频率描述符 我们用一个预测敏感属性的分类器来测量渗漏,即从单一描述符(Malekzadeh等人,2019年)开始的VWW的人-存在标签。 我们把描述式分类仪测试图像分为训练和测试(80:20),应用63个测试DAG,训练后勤回归,梯度激发树和MLP分类器. 我们重复了5次,并报告三个分类中最准确的平均值(±\\\pm\sigma)。 我们使用平衡的精确度,即人和无人精度的平均值,因为VWW不是一个平衡的数据集. 我们观察到,最准确的窃听者获得58.5±2.4%58.5\pm}2.4\%(DCT at 第4848号决议),因此,描述者带有一个弱的人-存在信号,而不是披露属性。 我们注意到,渗漏量在每一段描述词的最低描述分辨率下最低,而且随着分辨率的增长,渗漏量饱和:平均超过三个描述词,将分辨率从2424提高到4848,使适应收益增加1.01.0页,渗漏增加1.31.3页,而从48提高到96,则增加0.40.4页,渗漏增加0.30.3页。 因此,我们认为,描述性决议主要在最低分辨率范围内以适应性收益换取渗漏。

blocks.en: 6.6. Adaptation Latency on Smart Glasses
blocks.zh: 6.6. 智能眼镜的适应性

blocks.en: We measure the end-to-end latency of the adaptation loop on a Seeed Grove Vision AI V2 board (Himax WiseEye2, Cortex-M55), the processor class of the Brilliant Labs Halo smart glasses ( Brilliant Labs, 2026 ) , running the VWW MobileNetV1 architecture as an int8 model ( David et al., 2020 ) . Over 10 10 adaptation runs (DCT resolution 96, laptop CPU host), one adaptation requires 85 ± 9 85{\pm}9 s: the synthesis of the image adaptation set ( 41 ± 3 41{\pm}3 s) and the cross-entropy forward-backward pass ( 44 ± 7 44{\pm}7 s) account for 98% of the time. The descriptor computation, the update of the adapted subspace in SRAM and the first adapted inference require 38 38 ms on the device. The transfer of the 708 708 B descriptor and of the 22 22 kB update requires 0.14 0.14 s at the 1.32 Mbit/s measured for BLE 5 ( Wang, 2020 ) . On a Samsung Galaxy S23 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2) using four CPU cores, the host passes require 84 ± 9 84{\pm}9 s and 218 ± 7 218{\pm}7 s over 5 5 runs. The energy consumption of the host stages and their mobile GPU implementation, for which to the best of our knowledge no off-the-shelf framework exists, are left for future work.

blocks.en: 7. Discussion
blocks.zh: 7个 讨论情况

blocks.en: This paper analyzes whether deployment-time model adaptation for smart glasses can be driven by compact frequency descriptors instead of transmitted camera frames. NFJF recovers most of the accuracy gain of supervised adaptation across six backbones and three tasks: it closes 82 % 82\% of the oracle adaptation gap on VWW, 93 % − 95 % 93\%-95\% on ImageNet, and 94 % − 98 % 94\%-98\% on MS-COCO detection (Fig. 2 , Table 2 ), while the per-frame uplink never exceeds 832 832 B. In contrast, the entropy minimization ( Oracle - E ) destabilizes on the self-attention and hybrid ImageNet architectures and on VWW.
blocks.zh: 本文分析智能眼镜的部署时间模型适应性是否可以由紧凑的频率描述符而不是传输的相机帧驱动. NFJF在六个主干线和三个任务中恢复了监督适应的大部分精度收益:它关闭了VWW上82%的oracle适应缺口;在ImageNet上93%-95%的93\%-95\%;在MS-CO检测上94%-98%的94\%-98\%(图2,表2),而每帧上行链路从未超过832 832 B. 与此相对照的是,将entropy最小化(Oracle-E)破坏了自觉和混合的ImageNet架构和VWW.

blocks.en: Outlook. There are several directions to extend this work. First, the adaptation loop consumes each test DAG independently, re-initialized from the pre-trained parameters; extending it to DAGs that drift over time would move the framework to a continual setting. Second, the descriptor resolution trades adaptation accuracy against uplink bandwidth; a controller that dynamically selects this resolution per-shift and available computational resources could lower the average uplink overhead without sacrificing adaptation accuracy on the hardest DAGs. Third, since progressive JPEG delivers the DCT DC coefficient of each 8 × 8 8\times 8 block in the first decode pass ( Wallace, 1992 ) , the edge device can compute the lowest-resolution descriptor and transmit it while the frame is decoding, overlapping the host adaptation with the remaining decode.
blocks.zh: 展望. 扩展这项工作有几个方向。 首先,适应循环独立地消耗每个测试的DAG,从预先训练的参数重新初始化;将其扩展至随时间而漂移的DAG,将框架移动到一个连续的设定. 第二,描述式分辨率以上行链路带宽进行适应精度交易;动态选择此分辨率每班和可用计算资源的控制器可以降低平均上行链路的间接费用,同时又不牺牲最困难的DAG的适应精度. 第三,由于进步JPEG在第一个解码通道(Wallace,1992年)中提供每个8×8 8\times 8块的DCTDC系数,边缘设备可以计算最低分辨率的描述符,并在帧进行解码时传输,将主机的适应与剩余解码重叠.

blocks.en: Limitations. First, the figures and tables use a single classifier seed; Sec. 6.2 shows that the standard deviation of the post-adaptation accuracy across classifier seeds falls below the standard deviation across transmitted descriptors at every resolution. Second, the adaptation loop reproduces only corruptions from the modeled ten-operator DAG family (Table 1 ): a shift outside this family ( e.g. , motion blur or fog) is mapped to the most similar modeled DAG in the descriptor space, thus the host adapts on a different corruption. We expect part of the adaptation gain when similar frequency bands are altered and an accuracy below No Adapt otherwise, as for the incorrectly predicted test DAGs at resolution 28 28 (Fig. 4 ). Filtering unreliable stage predictions and extending the corruption family remain future work. Third, whether the adaptation loop transfers to vision-language models increasingly deployed on smart glasses ( Liu et al., 2025 ) is untested. We hope this work sparks interest in adaptation systems that communicate compact frequency descriptors rather than camera frames, narrowing the gap between bandwidth-efficient and continuous model adaptation.
blocks.zh: 限制。 首先,数字和表格使用一个单一的分类种子; 第6.2条显示,分类种子的适应后精度标准偏差低于每个分辨率的传输描述符的标准偏差. 其次,适应循环只复制了模型十操作者DAG家族的腐败(表1):在这个家族外的转变(如运动模糊或雾)被映射到描述空间中最相似的模型DAG,因此宿主在不同的腐败上适应. 我们预计,当类似的频段被改变,准确度低于“不适应”时,将获得部分适应收益,因为第28(图4)号决议中的DAG测试预测不正确。 过滤不可靠的阶段预测和扩大腐败家庭仍然是今后的工作。 第三,适应循环向视觉语言模型的转移是否越来越多地部署在智能眼镜上(Liu等人,2025年)没有经过测试. 我们希望这项工作能激发人们对交流紧凑频率描述符而不是相机帧的适应系统的兴趣,缩小带宽高效和连续模型适应之间的差距.
